people.evidence_claim: Trump Files Ethics Complaints Against NY AG Over Trump University Probe

people.name: Eric Schneiderman
people.evidence_claim: Trump filed ethics complaints and publicly accused New York Attorney General Eric Schneiderman of improper conduct after the state sued Trump University for fraud. The move sought to paint the investigation as political while escalating the legal and public pressure campaign. Critics described it as intimidation against a law‑enforcement official overseeing a case involving Trump’s business.

people.name: Khizr Khan
people.evidence_claim: After Khizr Khan criticized him at the Democratic National Convention, Trump attacked the Gold Star father and suggested his wife was not “allowed to speak.” The public dispute with a family whose son was killed in Iraq drew bipartisan condemnation. The episode became a defining moment in the 2016 campaign for its cruelty and divisiveness.
